findings.title: Potential division by zero when ratings list is empty
findings.explanation: The function computes sum(ratings) / len(ratings) without checking if the list is empty. If an empty list is passed, len(ratings) is zero, causing a ZeroDivisionError at runtime.
findings.verdict_reason: The only call site checks for an empty ratings list before invoking mean_rating, preventing division by zero.
